_about: Bai Juyi's postings: the gold thread on the timeline. 'from' and 'to' are years CE (decimals for part of a year, e.g. 822.8 = autumn 822). Drafted with AI help from the standard chronology; set 'verified' to true once checked against Zhu Jincheng's chronology (白居易年譜) or 箋校.
source: Zhu Jincheng 朱金城, 白居易年譜 (Shanghai Guji, 1982)

stations.en: Passes the jinshi examination (800); collator in the Palace Library (803)
Hanlin academician and Reminder of the Left; the New Yuefu years
Mourning for his mother at Weicun, Xiagui
Demoted to marshal of Jiangzhou; the thatched cottage on Mount Lu
Prefect of Zhongzhou on the upper Yangtze

stations.post: 主客郎中知制誥 · 中書舍人
stations.en: Recalled to court; drafter of edicts and Secretariat Drafter
Sinecure post in the Eastern Capital
Director of the Palace Library, then Vice Minister of Justice

stations.post: 太子賓客分司 · 河南尹 · 太子少傅
stations.en: Settles in Luoyang for good: Guest of the Heir Apparent, Governor of Henan (830–833), retires as Minister of Justice (842); dies 846
